sources.summary: Artist and caricaturist who co-created the hugely popular ITV satire Sptting Image with Roger Law Peter Fluck, who has died aged 85, was, with his fellow artist Roger Law, half of the Fluck & Law partnership that revived satire on TV with Spitting Image, the ITV puppet sketch show lampooning celebrities, politicians and the royal family. Two decades after the BBC’s That Was the Week That Was spoofed the British establishment and, in particular, the last days of Harold Macmillan ’s Conservative government at the time of the John Profumo affair, Spitting Image, from 1984 to 1996, mined another period of Tory rule rich in distinctive characters, exaggerating elements of their personalities.
